newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah little changed in dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah little changed in dull trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was little changed against the dollar in late trading on Thursday.
Dealers said there was not much activity in the afternoon as many operators had left early for long weekend.
Jakarta foreign exchange market will be closed for Eid al-Fitr on February 10 and 11 inclusive, while the stock market will be closed from February 7 to 11 inclusive.
They said public holidays in Singapore and Hong Kong seemed to have slowed down overall activity.
One foreign bank dealer said liquidity turned around sharply in the afternoon, causing overnight money to drop to around four percent from an early high of 14.25 percent.
But the dealer said the high volatility in the money market resulted from differing anticipations of liquidity conditions, coupled with heavy offshore covering with short-term swaps.
Overnight swaps were at 0.6/0.8 and tom/next at 4.00/4.25.
Spot rupiah was at 2,377.0/77.25, compared with an opening of 2,377.5/78.0. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,372.30/72.65 and 2,371.00/71.85, respectively.
One local bank dealer said there might be two reasons explaining the heavy short-covering in short-term swaps.
"Offshore players are maintaining long dollar positions or they anticipate the central bank might be forced to buy dollars in the near future," the dealer said.

He said an intervention from the bank would result in fresh rupiah injection which might drive swap rates down, triggering players to establish short positions in long-term swaps in advance, while covering them with short-term commitments.
One-month swaps were at 14.25/15.00, two at 29.0/30.5, three at 40.0/41.0 and six at 79.50/80.75 points.
The central bank raised its intervention band by one point to 2,375/2,567 and the conversion band to 2,375/2,423 on Thursday, the third depreciation this week.
The bank depreciated the rupiah by three points last week after lowering it by two points the previous week.
